name: SVG to PNG/JPG Exporter at Custom Sizes

seo.title: SVG to PNG/JPG Exporter at Custom Sizes — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Rasterize a sanitized SVG to exact PNG or JPEG dimensions entirely in the browser.

assumptions: External scripts/resources are removed and remote URL references are not fetched.
limitations: Unsupported external fonts or filters may render differently from the original authoring environment.
